items.old_text: # Readout accuracy depends on how a moving memory is observed {#ch:MEMORY-READOUT}
items.new_text: # Readout accuracy depends on how a moving memory is observed {#ch:MEMORY-READOUT}

items.old_text: When a recall cue arrives, the stored value has already moved. Later spikes can help estimate the value present at that cue, but they cannot reveal the particular random displacements that occurred before it. Waiting for more spikes also allows the network to move further. The question is how much observation helps when the value being read keeps changing.
items.new_text: When a recall cue arrives, the stored value has already moved. Later spikes can help estimate the value present at that cue, but they cannot reveal the particular random displacements that occurred before it. Waiting for more spikes also allows the network to move further. The question is how much observation helps when the value being read keeps changing.

items.old_text: Separating the error accumulated during storage from the error of reading the cue state makes that question precise. Equal weighting of later observations shows why simply waiting can become harmful. Allowing for the state's motion then shows how observation can keep helping toward a limit, and how access to only some spikes changes the useful duration. The time constants and noise assumptions also need checking before the resulting limits can be compared with the paper's final error claim.

items.old_text: When a continuous attractor circuit is used to accumulate an incoming signal over time, its stored value represents the integral of that signal. The short useful readout interval does not imply a short lifetime for this accumulated value. A tuned circuit can continue to represent the mean of accumulated inputs while its variance grows. A leak would instead pull its mean toward a particular value. Diffusion limits the accuracy of the integral and the usefulness of long observation; it does not by itself introduce that restoring pull. Applying these predictions to an animal also requires checking its spike statistics, tuning, drift, access to spikes, and other sources of movement noise.[^p1-integrator]
